mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (bill_id, customer_id, amount, payment_method, payment_no, payer_type, operator_id, pay_time, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{billId}, #{customerId}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentNo}, #{payerType}, #{operatorId}, #{payTime}, #{payTime}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, bill_id, customer_id, amount, payment_method, payment_no, payer_type, operator_id, pay_time, create_time, deleted FROM payment_record WHERE bill_id = #{billId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY pay_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, bill_id, customer_id, amount, payment_method, payment_no, payer_type, operator_id, pay_time, create_time, deleted FROM payment_record WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY pay_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
